title: Beyond The Bedrock
description: they let you into their world. will you let them into yours?
body:
## BEYOND THE BEDROCK

Beyond the Bedrock is a horror mod inspired by untitled.log, no_moon.jar, wonderland.jar, and The Broken Script. its not great as this is my first mod so sorry its kind just slop i suck at mods

A breach has been made in the bedrock, and the things under it start corrupting your world. The more you play, the more corrupted it gets.

The mod focuses on creating 4th wall-breaking events; we want your world to be ours type of stuff.

### Features

<details>

<summary>Spoilers!</summary>

* 18 unique horror events

* 6 entities with different behaviors and encounter mechanics

* 3 dimensions that all link together

* 2 rare one-time events

* Fake error messages and game interruptions

* Window manipulation effects

* Visual anomalies

* some lore to discover

</details>

### Important

This mod can manipulate your game window. Certain events may intentionally crash the game or display fake error messages.

Most effects can be configured using the config.

For the best experience, windowed mode is recommended. Fullscreen is supported, but some effects may not function correctly.

### Photosensitivity Warning

This mod contains flashing overlays and visual effects.

If you have photosensitivity, these effects can be disabled through the config.

Configuration is currently stored per-world, meaning settings must be adjusted separately for each new world.

More content is planned as the mod continues development and remains in beta.
